diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong downward trend (a net fall of ~45% of its level). There is little seasonal structure. A few outliers stand out (3 points, ~0% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is moderate (Kendall tau 0.478), which favours a weighted combination.
